about: The line every Sales Order shows, in a list and when opened, about SAP: whether SAP has it, who approved it, and SAP's order numbers.
why: Asked for by the user on 26 Nov 2026: once a manager or the GM approves an order and it goes to SAP, the order must always say 'Sent to SAP', whether the GM or a manager approved it, and the SAP Sales Order number. The two apps must say the same thing about the same order.

the_shape.custom_gm_approved_by: Stamped by the GM's approval (Approve, or Approve & Push to SAP since 17 Nov 2026); kept through the manager's push; cleared by a rejection or a fresh escalation.
the_shape.custom_mt_sales_order: Manna Treads SAP's DocNum (MANNA_TREADS_LIVE), written by the order sync's PASS M.
the_shape.custom_sap_sales_order: Hi-Tech SAP's DocNum (HITECH_PRETREADS_LIVE), written by PASS A on the older route and PASS H on the Manna Treads first route.

rules.sent_means_sap_has_a_number: 'Sent to SAP' shows only when SAP has written its order number back: custom_mt_sales_order or custom_sap_sales_order. Pressing Approve & Push only ASKS the order sync to send it; until a number comes back the order reads 'Waiting for SAP'. Nothing else counts - not the push request, not the approval status.
rules.either_company_is_enough: On the Manna Treads first route Manna Treads' order is made first and Hi-Tech's later by B1if, so either number alone means SAP has the order.
rules.both_numbers_are_shown: When both companies hold the order, both numbers are shown, Manna Treads first. Neither is derived from the other: DocNum series differ by company.
rules.gm_approved_is_the_gm_stamp: An approved order (PO Approved - Ready for SAP) reads 'GM Approved' when custom_gm_approved_by is set - the GM approved it, whether the GM or the sales manager then pushed it - and 'Manager Approved' when it is not. Pending Final Approval claims nothing here: the GM has approved and the manager has yet to push, and both apps already say 'GM Approved' for that status on their own stage pill.
rules.no_approver_without_an_approval: Any status but PO Approved - Ready for SAP claims no approver here, even when SAP has the order. An order the sync sent before it was approved (18 and 23 Nov 2026) is not approved by anybody; the dashboard's track flags it in red.
rules.unset_reads_three_ways: An unset field reads back as null, '' or the string 'null'. All three are empty.

cases.why: a new order waiting for the manager says nothing about SAP
a manager's approval with no SAP number yet is waiting for SAP, never sent
a manager's approval that Manna Treads SAP has is sent, with its number
an order both companies hold shows both numbers, Manna Treads first
an order on the older route has only Hi-Tech's number, and that is enough
the GM's approve and push reads GM Approved once SAP has it
an order the GM approved and the manager pushed is still GM Approved
the GM has approved but the manager has not pushed: nothing here, the stage pill already says GM Approved
an order the sync sent before approval is in SAP but approved by nobody
a rejected order claims no approver, even with a number SAP still holds
an unset field read back as the string null is empty, not an order number

news_rules.who: Asked for by the user on 26 Nov 2026: for now only the sales managers and the GM are told when an order reaches SAP. Reps are not notified.
news_rules.news_is_a_diff: There is no server push. Each device remembers which orders it has already seen in SAP, and an order SAP has now that is not in that list is the news - the same approach as stage_watch.json.
news_rules.first_look_is_the_baseline: A device that has never looked (seen is null) reports nothing and remembers every order already in SAP. A manager signing in for the first time must not get fifty notifications for last month's orders.
news_rules.seen_only_grows: Orders stay in the seen list after they drop out of what is read, so an old order that comes back into the window is not news again.
news_rules.only_sent_counts: An order without a SAP number is neither news nor remembered; it becomes news the first time a number appears.

news.why: the first look reports nothing and remembers what is already in SAP
an order that got its SAP number since the last look is news
Hi-Tech's number arriving on an order already seen in Manna Treads SAP is not news again
an approved order still waiting for SAP is neither news nor remembered
an order no longer read stays remembered, so it cannot come back as news
